{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

df_duplicates = df[duplicate_patients]

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}")
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}")
print(f"Unique patient_id count: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")"}
